name: Chart/Bar-Chart
description:
Bar chart: one measure per period or category. Vertical: 12 columns on a dashed grid (solid baseline), bars in Chart/Sector/Primary that fill the plot edge to edge, Spacing/Gap/XSmall (8) apart and as wide as the count allows, Corner-Radius/Small on the top corners and a flat base, the active bar Chart/Sector/Secondary with its Tooltip and X pill, projected bars hatched (.Chart/Hatch). Horizontal: category pills, 24px bars Spacing/Gap/XSmall (8) apart, flat at the axis and Corner-Radius/Small at the end (they thicken in a taller card), over a hatched target track, a value axis 8px under the last row. Header: title, Hint (i) and open chevron; Metric Label over the value; ranges. Content only, no surface of its own: place it in a Chart-Card's (or a Card's) Content slot, and the card gives the theme. Code: BarChart + ChartCard (src/components/Chart)


Color: Primary (default) · Secondary — Secondary swaps Color Chart Sector/Primary and /Secondary (Secondary bars, the active bar Primary), for a chart led by Neutral Deep with the brand as its highlight. Code: palette="secondary".


Header: Title · Show Hint — an info icon (20px, Content/Neutral/Light) that holds the chart's description in a Tooltip (code: hint) · Show Open; Show Icon is off by default (chart headers carry no icon). Metric: Show Metric Label (Body/Small/Regular, what the figure is; code: metricLabel) over Show Value (Display/4).
